title: Explicit simplicial bar projective resolution of a cofibrant-valued diagram
statement:
Use the model and simplicial-model terminology of [lem-coef-simplicial-model-nerve-localization], and the projective diagram model structures of [lem-coef-model-colimit-localization-comparison]. Let $\mathcal M$ be a combinatorial simplicial model category, meaning that its underlying category is locally presentable and its two model weak factorization systems are generated by small sets. Here locally presentable means generated under $\kappa$-filtered colimits for some regular $\kappa$ by a small set of objects whose Hom functors preserve these colimits. Fix universes in which the ordinary category $I$ is small and let $V:I\to\mathcal M$ have cofibrant values. Use the simplex category and simplicial sets of [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set]. Write $X\otimes K$ for the simplicial tensor. For $p\geq0$ define an $I$-diagram
$$S_pV(j)=\coprod_{i_0\to\cdots\to i_p\to j}V(i_0).$$
Its action on $j$ postcomposes the final arrow. In the simplicial $p$ direction, $d_0$ applies $V(i_0\to i_1)$ to the value, internal faces compose adjacent arrows, the last face composes $i_{p-1}\to i_p\to j$, and degeneracies insert identities among $i_0,\ldots,i_p$. Define
$$QV(j)=\int^{[p]\in\Delta} S_pV(j)\otimes\Delta^p.$$
The coend is the coequalizer of the two maps from the coproduct over simplex operators to the coproduct over simplex objects, imposing the tensor/simplicial-operator relations; $\Delta^p=\operatorname{Hom}_\Delta(-,[p])$. Composition along the chain defines a natural augmentation $QV\to V$. The $I$-diagram $QV$ is projectively cofibrant and this augmentation is an objectwise weak equivalence. There is a natural isomorphism
$$\operatorname{colim}_{I}QV\cong R_I(V):=\int^{[p]\in\Delta}\left(\coprod_{i_0\to\cdots\to i_p}V(i_0)\right)\otimes\Delta^p.$$
Under this isomorphism every cocone $V\to\operatorname{const}A$ induces the same map to $A$ on both sides, by its component at $i_0$ followed by the tensor collapse $\Delta^p\to\Delta^0$. All constructions are functorial in maps of $I$-diagrams. The assertion includes the empty category $I$.

source.place: Dugger, A Primer on Homotopy Colimits, Section 9.2, Proposition 9.11, Corollary 9.8 and Remark 9.12 (the forward-chain version Q prime), printed pp.34-38; Section 19.1 and Theorem 19.4, printed pp.90-91, extend the construction to simplicial model categories. No Stacks tag states this simplicial model-category theorem. Read online 2026-10-17; not archived in literature/.
